headline: 60-year-old woman dies by suicide on railway tracks in Chuadanga
summary: Ayesha Begum reportedly ended her life in front of the Mahananda Express train near Munshiganj Railway Station due to financial distress and family illness.
details: A 60-year-old woman, identified as Ayesha Begum, died after jumping in front of a moving train near Munshiganj Railway Station in Alamdanga, Chuadanga, on Sunday.
According to police and local sources, Ayesha Begum arrived at the station area around 12 PM and inquired about the arrival of the train.
At approximately 12:45 PM, she jumped in front of the Khulna-bound Down Mahananda Express train, resulting in her death.
Local UP member Jasim Uddin stated that Ayesha Begum suffered from physical and mental illness and faced severe financial hardship.
The woman's son and daughter were also ill, and the costs of their medical treatment were reportedly unaffordable for her.
Chuadanga GRP police station in-charge SI Jagdish confirmed that the body was recovered from the scene and legal proceedings are currently underway.
caption:
A 60-year-old woman ended her life in front of a moving train in Chuadanga, reportedly driven by financial hardship and family illness.

A 60-year-old woman, identified as Ayesha Begum, died after jumping in front of a moving train near Munshiganj Railway Station in Alamdanga, Chuadanga, on Sunday.

According to police and local sources, Ayesha Begum arrived at the station area around 12 PM and inquired about the arrival of the train.

At approximately 12:45 PM, she jumped in front of the Khulna-bound Down Mahananda Express train, resulting in her death.

Local UP member Jasim Uddin stated that Ayesha Begum suffered from physical and mental illness and faced severe financial hardship.

The woman's son and daughter were also ill, and the costs of their medical treatment were reportedly unaffordable for her.

Chuadanga GRP police station in-charge SI Jagdish confirmed that the body was recovered from the scene and legal proceedings are currently underway.

#Chuadanga #Bangladesh #RailwayAccident #MentalHealth #News

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV
